Name: Perfection Tracking
Author: PapyRoach
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Perfection Tracking HUD shows what's left on your road to Perfection, right on your screen. A compact panel lists the 11 perfection categories with your progress, counted exactly like Qi's Perfection Tracker, along with your skill levels and what you can do today where you stand. Click any line to open a detailed menu listing every missing item, with hints on how to get it.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
- Perfection HUD: overall percentage (rounded down, like the game) and the 11 categories: produce and forage shipped, obelisks, Gold Clock, monster slayer goals, great friends, farmer level, stardrops, cooking, crafting, fish caught and golden walnuts.
- Same rules as the game's own calculation, so the numbers match Qi's statue. Items and villagers added by content mods are counted automatically.
- Click a HUD line to open the menu on that category, with the full list of what's missing. Hover a line for a quick preview.
- Hints on how to get each missing item: fish locations, seasons, hours, weather and crab pots; crop seasons; forage spots; recipe sources; villager birthdays and loved gifts shown as item icons; monster locations; stardrop sources.
- Watch list: tick any goal in the menu to keep it in the HUD. You get a notification when it's done. The list is saved per save file and per farmer.
- Pin a category with a right-click to see its first missing items right under its line.
- Today section: missing fish you can catch where you stand right now, today's birthday, crops in season you never shipped, forage available here.
- Skill bars with level and XP to the next level, a "+XP" popup when you gain experience, and Mastery once unlocked.
- Search box in the menu, by name or by hint.
- Everything can be turned on or off from the Options tab of the menu, or with Generic Mod Config Menu: each section, each category, each skill bar.
- Default keys: F7 shows or hides the HUD, F8 opens the menu. Both can be changed.
- Translated into the game's 12 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later.
- SMAPI 4.1.0 or later.
- Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu.
- Multiplayer and split-screen: each player sees their own progress. Note that in multiplayer, Qi's statue counts the best farmer in each category, while this mod shows the local player's progress. Multiplayer and split-screen have not been tested extensively yet, please report any issue.
